_about: Voter-footprint SEIFA per federal booth: vote-weighted mean SEIFA scores over the SA1s where the booth's VOTERS live (AEC 'Votes by SA1' roll mark-off x results product — AEC-flagged indicative, rounded), the footprint complement to the venue-proxy store booth-seifa-YYYY.json (SA1 of the premises). Votes SA1s are ASGS Ed3. Scores are SEIFA 2021, the 7-digit ccd decoded to SA1_CODE21 and joined to the 2021-census cube. Per-index ABS suppression: each index weights over its own covered votes (cov). Sentinel …9999 no-address SA1s are vote-counted but score-excluded. pp_id 0 rows are division declaration cohorts (Postal/Pre-Poll/Absent/Provisional), emitted per division, not per booth. Booths the votes file never lists (unused PPVCs, cancelled mobile teams) carry votes:null and note:noVotesRows. The divisions array re-pools every unit's per-SA1 demo tallies by division: one language/foreign-born/university/blue-collar/age/income reading per division plus the curated birthplace-country (cob) shares (same country-stated basis as fborn; country order in cobKeys), its shares from its own pooled sum, never from averaging the row-level rounded shares. The demo block folds the 2021-census GCP G01, G05, G07, G08, G09F/G09G/G09H, G14, G28, G32/G33, G37, G49B, G60B and G62 SA1 tables (G01: age-band structure (u15 the under-15 share of the stated ages); language spoken at home English-only vs other; the highest-year-of-schooling persons columns — the year-12-or-less share of the six printed stated levels (below-Year-12 = Year 11, Year 10, Year 9, Year 8 or below, did-not-go-to-school). G07: Indigenous status — the identifying share of the Indigenous-plus-non-Indigenous persons basis (status-not-stated excluded). G14: religious affiliation — the Religion menu's ten share options (rel, key order in relKeys, No-religion leading) ride the ex-affiliation-not-stated persons basis. G32's family-composition totals: the one-parent share of families (couple-with-children + couple-without-children + one-parent + other-family). G37: tenure by landlord — the Housing-tenure menu's four share options (ten, key order in tenKeys, owned-with-mortgage leading) ride the ex-tenure-not-stated occupied-private-dwellings basis, rented-public a state-or-territory-housing-authority landlord within that base. G09: country of birth — the overseas-born share excludes country-of-birth-not-stated, and the ten curated birthplace-country shares (cob, country order in cobKeys) ride the same country-stated basis. G49B: highest non-school qualification — the bachelor-and-above share is of the G01 aged-15-and-over population, excluding level-of-education-not-stated. G33 households by weekly income are re-weighted to ADULTS at the data/income-dist.json factors — each band's family households at that band's G32 family mix in the SA1 (national mix as fallback), non-family households at the national mean; loinc is the adult share below the national 25th-percentile weekly household-income cut the store-level incomeCuts record carries (the national histogram's cut band split linearly), hiinc the adult share in the $4,000-and-top band, incMed the band-interpolated median weekly household income in 2021 dollars on the HOUSEHOLD basis (ABS's own published-median basis — the adults-weighted histogram would read ~$300 higher, skewed by couples). G60B: occupation of employed persons — the blue-collar share counts the technicians-and-trades, machinery-operators-and-drivers and labourers major groups over the eight stated occupation groups, excluding inadequately-described/not-stated). The 2026-10-31 lanes arc: G62's commute share — any train, bus, tram or ferry leg of the counted employed-persons-with-stated-method journeys; G01's citizenship — residents not counted as Australian citizens (the GCP publishes no not-stated count for citizenship, so they're inside the complement as everywhere in this stack); G28's bigfam — women aged 15+ who have had three or more children ever born, over motherhood-stated women; G08's Ancestry-menu twelve shares (anc, key order in ancKeys) over persons ex the ancestry-not-stated responses — a person can name two ancestries so the options never partition residents, they count people per option; and the homeless lane, the ABS Estimating-homelessness 2049.0 SA2 estimates down-allocated to each SA1 by resident-population share — an SA2-area measure. G43's labour-force status (added 2026-11-10): the unemployed-looking-for-work share of the stated labour force (lfs_Tot_LF_* excludes status-not-stated by construction). G05's registered marital status (added 2026-11-11): the Marital status menu's five shares (mar, key order in marKeys, married leading) of people aged 15+, over the five printed categories' own sum — the table's Total folds a not-stated slice in, so its ex-not-stated basis is their sum. — all by the same per-SA1 vote weights — age shares renormalise over the 11 bands, which exclude age-not-stated; persons are a vote-weighted pseudo-population, never a headcount, and demo figures describe where the booth's voters lived in 2021, never who the voters themselves were — the ecological transport is the point of the weighting and its limit. Walk used for this lane: none needed (votes are already Ed3).

demoBasis: 2021 Census GCP G01, G05, G07, G08, G09F/G09G/G09H, G14, G28, G32/G33, G37, G43, G49B, G60B and G62 @ SA1 (Ed3), plus the ABS Estimating-homelessness 2049.0 SA2 estimates down-allocated by population share (cache/homeless-sa1-2021-alloc.json); every lane's votes are in Ed3 space before folding, walking older geographies via ABS correspondences
